hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm -rf (/|~|\\$HOME)|git reset --hard|git clean -[a-z]*f|drop table|truncate table|DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command. Spec forbids mass rollback without the owner; DB writes go through a migration file, not ad-hoc SQL.' >&2; exit 2; fi
